questions.question: Where was Ezekiel taken in a vision in chapter 8?
options: To Babylon, to see all of the captives in their exile
To a very high mountain, to look out over the whole land
To the deep valley, to see the dry and scattered bones
To Jerusalem, to see the abominations in the temple
questions.answer: To Jerusalem, to see the abominations in the temple

questions.question: What abomination did Ezekiel see being committed in the temple?
options: Foreign armies all encamped within the walls of the holy temple courts
Idolatry, including elders worshiping images and men bowing to the sun
Murder committed openly in the broad and full daylight of the temple courts
The bold theft of the gold and the silver vessels of the holy sanctuary
questions.answer: Idolatry, including elders worshiping images and men bowing to the sun

questions.question: God showed Ezekiel 'greater abominations' progressively in the temple vision.
He brought me to the entrance of the court, and I saw a hole in the _____.
About twenty-five men were bowing down to the _____ toward the east.
